verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is indirect. Meilisearch stores your documents and embeddings, and it can be self-hosted as a single binary on your own Linux, macOS or Windows machines or containers. That implies you control where data lives and can remove it, but the pack never documents deletion or retention controls. missing for 10: documented document/index deletion APIs, retention or TTL policies, deletion of stored embeddings, Cloud-side data retention and deletion guarantees, independent corroboration.
